title: Performance World Sequence
description: A reference-led stage-world sequence that locks one performance universe and then explores lighting, screen, and material variations within it.
creative_direction: The root image establishes a complete stage world with floor material, screen motif, atmospheric palette, and performer silhouette. The following images preserve that world-building grammar while shifting emphasis to alternate lighting and scenic treatments.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-obsidian-stage first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-laser-tunnel-variant, 03-fog-curtain-variant, 04-mirror-riser-variant. Queue may run 02-laser-tunnel-variant, 03-fog-curtain-variant, 04-mirror-riser-variant concurrently after 01-reference-obsidian-stage is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
